message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on any incoming data; scraped content is passed directly into parsing and DataFrame construction without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: HTTP requests to the external website are made with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks; there is no pinning, signing, or hash validation of fetched content.

No detected label flipping detection: The code maps categories to integer IDs and replaces labels but never validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions for anomalies, or uses any label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs text cleaning and stopword removal but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs to defend against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: Although pickle is imported and used for model serialization, there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed when loading serialized models; files are loaded directly without integrity verification.

No detected label distribution validation: Although the code uses over/under-sampling (RandomOverSampler/RandomUnderSampler) and plots histograms of the target distribution, there is no explicit validation or assertion that checks class balance or the expected label set before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor or trigger detection mechanism anywhere in the training pipeline; no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or neural-cleanse-style defense is present.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation mechanism, data signing/hashing, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; evaluation metrics are imported but no protective controls are visible.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path passes scraped or uploaded text through preprocessing pipelines (cleaning, stemming, vectorization) without any explicit shape/range checks, schema validation, or rejection of malformed inputs.

No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model output probabilities for NaN values, out-of-range scores, or applies calibrated thresholds before returning predictions to the user.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a classical text classifier (Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
